name_reason: The constant is the additive vertical (y) offset of the per-slot y-coordinate: y[i] = (int)(angle_accumulator * sin(angle_rad) * 1.2 + 30.0). It is the '+ 30.0' addend, never an orbit radius -- the actual radius is the runtime angle_accumulator (data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_c_angle_accumulator, ramped +6/-6 in states 2/8). Descriptor 'radius' is therefore semantically inaccurate; 'y_offset' reflects the real role. Suffix '_30' encodes the constant value 30.0 (meaningful, retained -- not an address residue; address is 0x50233). Datatype is a scalar double const, so no array/table/flag suffix needed. The sibling y-amplitude scale 1.2 @ 0x5022B is data_fd2_animation_summon_radial_angle_step_12 (out of scope). RECORDED ONLY; rename applied in Stage 2.
purpose: Summon-spell variant-C 5-slot radial animation per-slot y-coordinate additive vertical offset (constant 30.0 screen-y bias).
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial (@ 0x26E39) consumes it at 0x27039 via FADD double ptr [0x50233] as the trailing '+ 30.0' term of y[i] = (int)(angle_accumulator * sin(angle_rad) * 1.2 + 30.0). The FADD 8-byte operand fixes type double. Pairs with the y-amplitude scale 1.2 @ 0x5022B (FMUL at 0x27033). No writers.
element_semantics: Scalar constant: the fixed vertical (screen-y) offset added to each summon variant-C slot's computed y-coordinate after the sin*amplitude term.
notes: Ghidra DATATYPE=double len=8; single READ xref from 0x27039 (no writers) -> const confirmed. Data plate was previously misplaced in PRE_COMMENT (PLATE_COMMENT null) and framed the value as 'orbit radius'; corrected per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism: wrote PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API (cu.setComment(CodeUnit.PLATE_COMMENT,...)) with y-offset framing consistent with src, and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT. src comment (anitab.c lines 25-39) already accurate ('y-offset (vertical bias)'); left unchanged. No logic/type/value/signature changes made.
